name: Durham Parcels (AGOL hosted, primary)
notes: query?where=PIN='<pin>'&outFields=*&f=json ; or where=LOCATION_ADDR LIKE '<addr>%'. Has PIN,REID,ZONING,ACREAGE,PROPERTY_OWNER,DEED_BOOK/PAGE,TOTAL_*_VALUE_ASSESSED.

name: Durham Parcels (on-prem mirror)
notes: same tax dataset as hosted; fallback.

name: Durham Zoning polygons
notes: polygon layer; spatial-intersect with parcel geometry. Planning svc also has watershed(3), airport-overlay(6), historic(1,2,10,11), UGB(24).

name: Durham Flood Zones (development)
notes: ZoneCode: AEFW=floodway, AE/AO/A=SFHA, X*=outside. Spatial-intersect with parcel.

name: Durham Address Points
notes: layer 2 = Tax Districts.

name: Durham Tax / Property Record (Spatialest)
notes: JS app, no public API -> Playwright for photo/sketch/permit-history/>3yr-sales. Core assessment data already in REST parcels. Try CAMA first: https://taxcama.dconc.gov/camapwa/

name: Durham Register of Deeds
notes: deeds/plats by grantor/grantee/book-page; pair with parcel DEED_BOOK/PAGE. Disclaimer gate.

name: NCDEQ Solid Waste Section
notes: open-dump / landfill records; contact Permitting Branch Head.

name: NCDEQ Recognized Environmental Consultants (REC) list
notes: approved consultants for waste-boundary + soil/GW/gas assessment.

name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
notes: NWI wetlands; also an ArcGIS service available.

name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
notes: authoritative FEMA flood; Durham flood layer usually sufficient locally.

name: NCDOT SR / road-maintenance lookup
notes: confirm whether a street is NCDOT-maintained (buildability access gate)

name: Doorify MLS (RESO Web API) / agent CSV export
notes: RESO Web API feed needs MLS-issued creds (Trestle/Bridge/Spark) in .env: MLS_API_BASE + MLS_API_TOKEN or MLS_OAUTH_*. Easiest: agent CSV export -> propkb mls ingest-csv.

name: Census ACS + FBI CDE + Durham Open Data (+ aggregators)
notes: authoritative: Census ACS (demographics), FBI Crime Data Explorer + Durham PD open data (crime). Aggregators bestneighborhood/areavibes/crimegrade/neighborhoodscout fetch fine (no bot wall) but are secondary/modeled.

name: Wake Parcels (iMAPS)
notes: query?where=PIN_NUM='<pin>'&outFields=*&f=json ; or where=SITE_ADDRESS LIKE '<addr>%'. Fields: PIN_NUM,REID,OWNER,SITE_ADDRESS,DEED_BOOK/PAGE/DATE/ACRES,LAND_VAL,BLDG_VAL,TOTAL_VALUE_ASSD,PLANNING_JURISDICTION (WC/RA/CA/...),LAND_CLASS_DECODE,TOTSALPRICE,SALE_DATE. REID joins tax portal; DEED_BOOK/PAGE joins ROD CRPI. Native SR 2264 -> pass outSR=4326.

name: FEMA NFHL Flood Hazard Zones (Wake)
notes: layer 28 = Flood Hazard Zones. Fields FLD_ZONE (A/AE/X/...), ZONE_SUBTY (FLOODWAY/minimal), SFHA_TF, STATIC_BFE. Wake regulates off FEMA DFIRM; NFHL is canonical. Spatial-intersect.

name: Wake Address Points (iMAPS)
notes: PIN_NUM joins parcels; FULLADDR, POSTAL_CITY, X/Y. Updated nightly.

name: Wake County Zoning (unincorporated)
notes: layer 17 = County zoning; field CLASS (district code), ZON_NUM, DATE_ZONED. Same FeatureServer has per-town layers: Apex14,Angier15,Cary16,FuquayVarina18,Garner19,HollySprings20,Knightdale21,Morrisville22,Rolesville24,WakeForest25,Wendell26,Zebulon27. Raleigh=separate server.

name: Wake Real Estate / Tax Portal
notes: search by REID/PIN/address/owner. Tax deep-link: services.wake.gov/TaxPortal/Property/SearchByReid. Core assessment data already in REST parcels; portal for comps/appeals/tax-bill/sketch.

name: Wake Register of Deeds (CRPI)
notes: Consolidated Real Property Index; search Book/Page (from parcel DEED_BOOK/PAGE), name, instrument. Back to 1785.

name: Wake Septic (iMAPS, INCOMPLETE) + Env Health
notes: layer 0 self-flagged INCOMPLETE -> do NOT rely on. Authoritative: Wake Env Services / Onsite Water Protection, septic+well permits & soil evals, 919-856-7434, wastewater@wake.gov. Soils: USDA SSURGO (no Wake REST).

name: Raleigh Zoning
notes: layer 0 = Raleigh Zoning. Fields ZONE_TYPE, ZONE_TYPE_DECODE, ZONING (full string), OVERLAY, HEIGHT, FRONTAGE.

name: Cary Zoning (Wake FeatureServer layer 16)
notes: field CLASS.

notes: field CLASS.

notes: field CLASS.
